How have U.S. road deaths changed year by year from 2013 to 2022?
SELECT year, sum(try_cast(fatals AS integer)) AS deaths FROM govblock_vehicles.fars_accident WHERE try_cast(year AS integer) BETWEEN 2013 AND 2022 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which arXiv subjects saw the most papers revised four or more times?
SELECT primary_category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE try_cast(substr(latest_version, 2) AS integer) >= 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections of Texas law are recorded as repealed?
SELECT count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE state = 'tx' AND act_status = 'repealed'
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which Apple insiders have filed the most trading reports?

SELECT o.rptownername, max(o.rptowner_title) AS title, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission s JOIN govblock_sec.sec_insider_reportingowner o ON o.accession_number = s.accession_number WHERE s.issuertradingsymbol = 'AAPL' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many active community water systems are there in the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which counties produced the largest GDP in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published patent applications contributed reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications
Which European countries get the most out of their onshore wind on average?
SELECT country, avg(try_cast(cf AS double)) AS avg_capacity_factor FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_pecd_pecd_country_onshore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many insider reports filed in 2021 were amendments to earlier Form 4s?
SELECT count(*) AS amendments FROM govblock_sec.sec_insider_submission WHERE document_type = '4/A' AND filing_date LIKE '%-2021'
Which states have the highest median gross rent?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_rent FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.variable = 'B25064_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have benefit plans reported paying insurance brokers in commissions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(ins_broker_comm_pd_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_a_part1
What is the median household income in Kings County, New York, in the 2020 to 2024 American Community Survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36047' AND variable = 'B19013_E001'
How many people filed to run for president in 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cand_id) AS candidates FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'P' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
Where do medical device problems happen most often: hospitals, homes or clinics?
SELECT event_location, count(*) AS reports FROM govblock_health.fda_device_event GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do informal, formal and judicial enforcement compare for water permit violations?
SELECT activity_type_desc, count(*) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average molecular mass of a compound in PubChem?
SELECT avg(try_cast(c2 AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass
Which states filed the most returns with incomes of $200,000 or more for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS returns FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE cast(agi_stub AS varchar) = '6' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the total value of goods imported from Canada in 2019?
SELECT max(try_cast(all_val_yr AS double)) AS imports FROM govblock_trade.census_imp_cty WHERE cty_name = 'CANADA' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2019'
Which organisations have deposited the most bioassays in PubChem?
SELECT depositorname, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2depositorname WHERE depositorname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Rhea's pH 7.3 compound mappings were set by hand rather than computed?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN origin = 'curation' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_chebi_ph7_3_mapping
Which kinds of provider are most common among those enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT provider_type_desc, count(*) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NSF awards to Texas institutions began in 2020?
SELECT count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE statecode = 'TX' AND substr(startdate, 7, 4) = '2020'
Which states have the most sections of law in the library?
SELECT state, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEBI compounds carry a negative charge?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_chemical_data WHERE charge < 0
Which New York grid zones produce the most rooftop solar?
SELECT zone_name, sum(try_cast(mw_value AS double)) AS mw_hours FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_btm_solar_btmestimatedactual GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many utility-scale wind turbines are there in Texas?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'TX'
Which dosage forms are most common among approved drug products?
SELECT dosage_form, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_products WHERE dosage_form IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many tax returns were filed from ZIP code 10001 for 2021?
Income by ZIP Code and County
SELECT sum(try_cast(n1 AS double)) AS returns FROM govblock_tax.soi_zip_zpallagi WHERE zipcode = '10001' AND source_file LIKE '%/21zpallagi%'
Which categories of drinking water violation are most common?

SELECT CASE violation_category_code WHEN 'MCL' THEN 'Maximum contaminant level' WHEN 'MR' THEN 'Monitoring and reporting' WHEN 'MON' THEN 'Monitoring' WHEN 'RPT' THEN 'Reporting' WHEN 'TT' THEN 'Treatment technique' WHEN 'MRDL' THEN 'Maximum residual disinfectant level' ELSE violation_category_code END AS category, count(DISTINCT violation_id) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What are the ten most recent CRS reports with student loans in the title?
SELECT title, date FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND lower(title) LIKE '%student loan%' ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 10
How many people does a community water system serve on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(population_served_count AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which databases contribute the most compound records to UniChem?

SELECT s.name_long, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_chemistry.unichem_reference AS r JOIN govblock_chemistry.unichem_source AS s ON cast(s.src_id AS varchar) = cast(r.src_id AS varchar) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many NSF awards took effect each year from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) AS year, count(*) AS awards FROM govblock_grants.nsf_awards WHERE substr(awardeffectivedate, 7, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which models have the most complaints that involved a crash?
SELECT concat(maketxt, ' ', modeltxt) AS model, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints WHERE crash = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who ran for the U.S. Senate in Pennsylvania in 2024?
SELECT DISTINCT cand_name, cand_pty_affiliation FROM govblock_fec.candidates WHERE cand_office = 'S' AND cand_office_st = 'PA' AND cast(cand_election_yr AS varchar) = '2024'
How many ZIP code areas reach into Kings County, New York?
SELECT count(DISTINCT geoid_zcta5_20) AS zip_areas FROM govblock_census.rel2020_tab20_zcta520_county20 WHERE geoid_county_20 = '36047'
How many judicial confirmations were there each year from 2005 to 2014?

SELECT substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) BETWEEN '2005' AND '2014' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
How many bioassays does PubChem hold?
Which political organizations reported the most itemised contributions?
SELECT column03 AS organization, sum(try_cast(column15 AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_nonprofits.pol_org_8872_contributions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were total reported greenhouse gas emissions, in tons of carbon dioxide equivalent, in 2022?
SELECT sum(try_cast(co2e_emission AS double)) AS co2e FROM govblock_environment.ghg_facts_subp_ghg_emission WHERE year = '2022'
Which countries do inventors on U.S. patent applications come from most often?
SELECT inventor_country_code, count(*) AS inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of drinking water violations are classed as major?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN is_major_viol_ind = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_violations_enforcement WHERE is_major_viol_ind IS NOT NULL
Which drugs cost Medicaid the most nationwide in 2023?

SELECT product_name, sum(try_cast(total_amount_reimbursed AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.medicaid_sdud WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state = 'XX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many ChEMBL activity results reach a pChEMBL value of 9 or more?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_activities WHERE pchembl_value >= 9
What did the Department of Defense buy most in Hawaii in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT product_or_service_code_description, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_agency_name = 'DEPARTMENT OF DEFENSE' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'HI' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many final rules were published each year from 2015 to 2024?

SELECT substr(issue_date, 2, 4) AS year, count(*) AS rules FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE doc_type = '"RULE"' AND substr(issue_date, 2, 4) BETWEEN '2015' AND '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which counties in Florida have the oldest median age?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_age FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US12%' AND a.variable = 'B01002_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which Labor Department rules about overtime have appeared on the regulatory agenda?
SELECT DISTINCT rin, rule_title FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE acronym LIKE '%DOL%' AND lower(rule_title) LIKE '%overtime%' LIMIT 10
Which states send in the most vehicle safety complaints?
SELECT state, count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_complaints GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is aspirin's CAS registry number?
SELECT c1 AS cas_number FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c0 = '2244' AND c2 = 'CAS'
Which companies received the most federal contract money for work in Alaska in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'AK' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the average energy of the aspirin frames in revised MD17?
SELECT avg(energy_kcal_mol) AS average FROM govblock_chemistry.rmd17_frames WHERE molecule = 'aspirin'
Which statutes are cited most often as the cause of action in federal dockets?
SELECT cause, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE cause IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many compounds were confirmed active against HIV in the screening set?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.moleculenet_hiv WHERE activity = 'CA'
Which state constitutions are the longest?
SELECT state, sum(try_cast(word_count AS bigint)) AS words FROM govblock_law.law_combined WHERE document_type = 'constitution' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the GDP of Harris County, Texas, in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(_2023 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE geofips = '48201' AND linecode = '1'
Which parent companies offer the most Medicare Advantage plans in Texas?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County

SELECT parent_organization, count(DISTINCT concat(contract_id, '-', plan_id)) AS plans FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county WHERE state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies based outside the United States file financial statements with the SEC?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.sec_fsds_sub WHERE countryba <> 'US'
Which ATC anatomical groups contain the most drugs?
SELECT level1_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_atc_classification WHERE level1_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was per capita personal income in Manhattan in 2024?
SELECT try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_cainc1 WHERE geofips = '36061' AND linecode = '3'
Which medical specialties received the most industry money in 2021?

SELECT covered_recipient_specialty_1, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_general WHERE cast(program_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which medical subject heading is attached to PubChem compound 2244?
SELECT c1 AS mesh_heading FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mesh WHERE c0 = '2244' LIMIT 10
Which trial judges' rulings are appealed most often?
SELECT ordering_judge_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE ordering_judge_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the average size of a home loan made in California in 2023?
SELECT avg(try_cast(loan_amount AS double)) AS avg_loan FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2023' AND state_code = 'CA' AND cast(action_taken AS varchar) = '1'
Which drugs cost Medicare Part D the most in New York?
Medicare Part D Prescribers By Provider And Drug

SELECT gnrc_name, sum(try_cast(tot_drug_cst AS double)) AS cost FROM govblock_health.medicare_part_d_prescribers_by_provider_and_drug WHERE prscrbr_state_abrvtn = 'NY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Navy contract dollars in Virginia went to small businesses in fiscal year 2024?

SELECT contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE awarding_sub_agency_name = 'DEPT OF THE NAVY' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'VA' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2024' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Where do New York hospital patients go after they are discharged?
SELECT patient_disposition, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of Clean Water Act permit violations have drawn the most enforcement actions?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_violation_enforcements GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the lowest per capita income in 1950?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y1950 AS double) AS per_capita_income FROM govblock_economy.bea_sainc1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 10
Which agencies bought the most from small businesses in New York last fiscal year?

SELECT awarding_agency_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2025' AND contracting_officers_determination_of_business_size = 'SMALL BUSINESS' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which formal enforcement tools does EPA use most in water permit cases?
SELECT enf_type_desc, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What do federal campaigns spend money on most, by category?
SELECT category_desc, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS spent FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
